posts.text: Proud of our athletes who won 19 medals including 10 golds at the Asian U20 Athletics Championships. India's sporting future is incredibly bright. Congratulations to each one of them!

posts.text: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. The country demands answers.
posts.caption: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. The country demands answers.

posts.text: Inaugurated the Nausena Shaurya Vatika in Lucknow today. We are building a state where talent is recognized and defence heritage is honoured. Also felicitating our brilliant board exam students — they are the future of UP.

posts.text: The country needs an educated PM. CUET disruptions are just the latest failure — our students deserve better.
posts.caption: The country needs an educated PM. CUET disruptions are just the latest failure — our students deserve better.

posts.text: Our trade negotiations are focused on protecting Indian farmers while opening new avenues for growth. Every deal must work for India's people first.
posts.caption: Our trade negotiations are focused on protecting Indian farmers while opening new avenues for growth. Every deal must work for India's people first.

posts.text: India's economic fundamentals remain strong. Our focus continues on fiscal discipline, infrastructure investment, and ensuring growth reaches every corner of the country.
posts.caption: India's economic fundamentals remain strong. Our focus continues on fiscal discipline, infrastructure investment, and ensuring growth reaches every corner of the country.

posts.text: Being an entrepreneur is my dream job. Building infrastructure that transforms India's future — ports, energy, airports — this is what drives me every single day.
posts.caption: Being an entrepreneur is my dream job. Building infrastructure that transforms India's future — ports, energy, airports — this is what drives me every single day.

posts.text: We are strengthening governance, transparency, and accountability across Reliance as we prepare for the next phase of growth. Jio's mission to connect every Indian continues.
posts.caption: We are strengthening governance, transparency, and accountability across Reliance as we prepare for the next phase of growth. Jio's mission to connect every Indian continues.

posts.text: I have always believed that no success in business is truly meaningful unless it helps improve the lives of others. That remains the spirit of everything we do.
posts.caption: I have always believed that no success in business is truly meaningful unless it helps improve the lives of others. That remains the spirit of everything we do.

posts.text: India's youth are our greatest strength. Every initiative we take in education, skill development, and innovation is an investment in our nation's future.
posts.caption: India's youth are our greatest strength. Every initiative we take in education, skill development, and innovation is an investment in our nation's future.

posts.text: Talks are continuing, at a rapid pace, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. Just sit back and relax, it will all work out well in the end.
posts.caption: Talks are continuing, at a rapid pace, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. Just sit back and relax, it will all work out well in the end.

world.name: Rishi Sunak
world.role: Former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

posts.text: AI is the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we won't adopt and benefit from it at scale unless the public is reassured that it is safe.
posts.caption: AI is the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we won't adopt and benefit from it at scale unless the public is reassured that it is safe.

posts.text: Proud to have won the Ohio Republican primary with overwhelming support. Now it's time to fix Ohio — less bureaucracy, more opportunity, more freedom.
posts.caption: Proud to have won the Ohio Republican primary with overwhelming support. Now it's time to fix Ohio — less bureaucracy, more opportunity, more freedom.

world.name: Usha Vance
world.role: Second Lady of the United States

posts.text: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom and stave off summer learning loss. Prizes and friendly competition will add to the fun.
posts.caption: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom and stave off summer learning loss. Prizes and friendly competition will add to the fun.

posts.text: Our big security goal at the FBI is preparing for the 2026 World Cup — from traditional cop work to countering cyber threats and lone-wolf actors. We've created a special operations center at headquarters to centralize threat analysis.
posts.caption: Our big security goal at the FBI is preparing for the 2026 World Cup — from traditional cop work to countering cyber threats and lone-wolf actors. We've created a special operations center at headquarters to centralize threat analysis.

world.name: Sriram Krishnan
world.role: White House Senior AI Policy Advisor

posts.text: Our goal is reinvigorating US dominance in emerging technologies. The American AI stack — from semiconductors to frontier models — is what the world should be building on. We're projected to see $600 billion in AI infrastructure investment.
posts.caption: Our goal is reinvigorating US dominance in emerging technologies. The American AI stack — from semiconductors to frontier models — is what the world should be building on. We're projected to see $600 billion in AI infrastructure investment.

posts.text: We are at an inflection point for development. We've cut project approval times by one-third — from 19 to 13 months. The private sector is essential. There isn't enough government money to meet every need.
posts.caption: We are at an inflection point for development. We've cut project approval times by one-third — from 19 to 13 months. The private sector is essential. There isn't enough government money to meet every need.

world.name: Keir Starmer
world.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

posts.text: Social housing and reaching net zero are central to our mission. We're investing in homes, communities, and Britain's future while staying focused on practical delivery.
posts.caption: Social housing and reaching net zero are central to our mission. We're investing in homes, communities, and Britain's future while staying focused on practical delivery.

posts.text: Called out the dishonest gas tax campaign for what it is. Meanwhile, we're welcoming A$25 billion in investment from Microsoft — the largest single investment in Australian tech history.
posts.caption: Called out the dishonest gas tax campaign for what it is. Meanwhile, we're welcoming A$25 billion in investment from Microsoft — the largest single investment in Australian tech history.

posts.text: We are clearly bridging the gap we had in computing capacity in Europe. France is open for business, open for innovation, and leading the AI revolution in Europe.
posts.caption: We are clearly bridging the gap we had in computing capacity in Europe. France is open for business, open for innovation, and leading the AI revolution in Europe.

world.name: Mohammed bin Rashid
world.role: Vice President & Prime Minister of UAE, Ruler of Dubai

posts.text: Emirates Super Saturday reflects Dubai's leading position in global horse racing and the remarkable progress we have achieved in this sport. We will continue to build on this legacy and strengthen Dubai's stature as a global hub.

posts.text: Don't believe everything you read. Bloomberg publishes bs.
posts.caption: Don't believe everything you read. Bloomberg publishes bs.

posts.text: This is going to be a big year for delivering personal superintelligence. Businesses are willing to pay a portion of each sale in order to grow their revenue through AI.
posts.caption: This is going to be a big year for delivering personal superintelligence. Businesses are willing to pay a portion of each sale in order to grow their revenue through AI.

posts.text: Companies are already blowing through their annual token budgets and it's only May. At Google I/O we unveiled Gemini 3.5 Flash — our fastest, most capable model yet.
posts.caption: Companies are already blowing through their annual token budgets and it's only May. At Google I/O we unveiled Gemini 3.5 Flash — our fastest, most capable model yet.

posts.text: India is rapidly becoming a leader in AI innovation. 2026 is the defining year for AI at scale. We're investing A$25 billion in Australia alone.
posts.caption: India is rapidly becoming a leader in AI innovation. 2026 is the defining year for AI at scale. We're investing A$25 billion in Australia alone.

posts.text: AI should be able to help people in the physical world. Our long-term vision is everyone having a personal robot. And I'm delighted to be wrong about the AI jobs apocalypse.
posts.caption: AI should be able to help people in the physical world. Our long-term vision is everyone having a personal robot. And I'm delighted to be wrong about the AI jobs apocalypse.

posts.text: The response to MacBook Neo has been off the charts. Apple Maps was my first really big mistake. After nearly two decades, I'm handing the reins to John Ternus — Apple's best days are ahead.
posts.caption: The response to MacBook Neo has been off the charts. Apple Maps was my first really big mistake. After nearly two decades, I'm handing the reins to John Ternus — Apple's best days are ahead.

posts.text: Korea is a critical part of our ecosystem. Our Vera Rubin chips are in full production. The RTX Spark brings desktop-class AI to compact PCs.
posts.caption: Korea is a critical part of our ecosystem. Our Vera Rubin chips are in full production. The RTX Spark brings desktop-class AI to compact PCs.

posts.text: We are well prepared for this challenge. We will completely prepare our talent for this new age. AI won't make us obsolete — blending new AI models with legacy systems creates massive opportunities.
posts.caption: We are well prepared for this challenge. We will completely prepare our talent for this new age. AI won't make us obsolete — blending new AI models with legacy systems creates massive opportunities.

posts.text: There are too many urgent problems to solve for me to hold onto resources. I'm giving it all away.
posts.caption: There are too many urgent problems to solve for me to hold onto resources. I'm giving it all away.

posts.text: Open source is the backbone of today's digital economy and the foundation of modern AI. With Project Lightwell, we're helping define a new industry model to secure open source at its source.
posts.caption: Open source is the backbone of today's digital economy and the foundation of modern AI. With Project Lightwell, we're helping define a new industry model to secure open source at its source.

posts.text: It was really important that we got our strategy in place. AI will revolutionize how creativity happens. The bears have it all wrong — 850 million monthly users and growing.
posts.caption: It was really important that we got our strategy in place. AI will revolutionize how creativity happens. The bears have it all wrong — 850 million monthly users and growing.

posts.text: Building in AI is my focus now. The lessons from leading Twitter through its most turbulent chapter taught me resilience and clarity about what matters in technology.
posts.caption: Building in AI is my focus now. The lessons from leading Twitter through its most turbulent chapter taught me resilience and clarity about what matters in technology.

posts.text: What surprised me most about luxury was the human hand behind everything. We use exquisite raw materials and our production is rigorous, laborious, handmade.
posts.caption: What surprised me most about luxury was the human hand behind everything. We use exquisite raw materials and our production is rigorous, laborious, handmade.

posts.text: Syracuse was my first point of entry in the US. FedEx moves nearly $2 trillion worth of goods annually — AI and autonomous trucking will transform how we deliver.
posts.caption: Syracuse was my first point of entry in the US. FedEx moves nearly $2 trillion worth of goods annually — AI and autonomous trucking will transform how we deliver.

posts.text: We asked ourselves a question last year — can we go back to back? Here we are again. Come the big situation, you need the big guys to step up.
posts.caption: We asked ourselves a question last year — can we go back to back? Here we are again. Come the big situation, you need the big guys to step up.

posts.text: I'm not going to retire from this format. I still have a lot to offer and I'm excited for what's ahead.
posts.caption: I'm not going to retire from this format. I still have a lot to offer and I'm excited for what's ahead.

posts.text: The body has its limits but the love for the game never fades. I'll be back stronger. The support from fans means everything.
posts.caption: The body has its limits but the love for the game never fades. I'll be back stronger. The support from fans means everything.

posts.text: I'm back to my full pace. The niggle from the T20 World Cup is behind me. Ready to give everything for India.
posts.caption: I'm back to my full pace. The niggle from the T20 World Cup is behind me. Ready to give everything for India.

posts.text: I won't lie — I was mentally stressed and completely exhausted. But cricket has a way of teaching you to bounce back. I'm focused on what's next.
posts.caption: I won't lie — I was mentally stressed and completely exhausted. But cricket has a way of teaching you to bounce back. I'm focused on what's next.

posts.text: Everyone is talking about Sooryavanshi, and I watched him bat — it was magnificent. To see a 15-year-old play like that gives me goosebumps.
posts.caption: Everyone is talking about Sooryavanshi, and I watched him bat — it was magnificent. To see a 15-year-old play like that gives me goosebumps.

posts.text: In T20s, Sooryavanshi should be included right away, but not in Test cricket. He has to score more runs in first-class cricket. But at the moment he's just too talented. He is India's future.
posts.caption: In T20s, Sooryavanshi should be included right away, but not in Test cricket. He has to score more runs in first-class cricket. But at the moment he's just too talented. He is India's future.
